MASHENSTEIN — SCREEN GALLERY every UI screen and cabinet, portrait vs. landscape

Asset gallery history Latest asset gallery

Captured 2026-09-18 at commit e03becf from a live, running game (`npm run dev`) -- not isolated art. Landscape is 852×393, portrait is 393×852: an iPhone 15 Pro's own logical points in each orientation. A screen with no portrait badge has not been given a portrait layout, so its portrait shot is exactly what a player sees today: the same landscape frame, small and centred.
